description: Daily and yearly kWh and the cost to run any appliance from its wattage, hours of use and your electricity rate. Formula: kWh per day = watts × hours ÷ 1,000; kWh per year = kWh per day × days; cost = kWh × rate.

rate_per_kwh.description: Your electricity rate (from your bill) ($/kWh); default 0.15

watts.description: Appliance wattage (nameplate, or amps × volts) (W); default 1500
